releases.name: GroundCore 2026-04-05
releases.body: First release. A planting planner for the Mohave Valley desert region with a row spacing calculator, a plant lookup that fills in recommended spacing, a plant browser with category filters, and a map sandbox for laying out rows, structures, and drives.

jobs.description: Desert planting planner with row spacing, plant lookup, and a map sandbox for laying out rows.

releases.name: Mission Operator 2026-03-26
releases.body: First release. A scanner console that uses the device location to list nearby aircraft from live flight data, along with cell towers, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, ham repeaters, and mesh nodes. Includes a logbook and settings.

jobs.description: Location aware scanner console for nearby aircraft, radios, mesh nodes, and towers.

releases.name: Suno Forge 2026-04-05
releases.body: First release. A song builder that drafts lyrics and a style string from a genre, mood, and structure, with EDM drop and pump options and copy buttons for each part. Fixed the left panel sitting under other content.

jobs.description: Song builder that drafts lyrics and style tags for AI music generators.

releases.name: Gridmark 2026-04-14
releases.body: First release. A map tool that saves work and personal locations with notes, draws a heatmap, and records a GPS track every 10 seconds. All data stays on the device.

jobs.description: GPS location marker and heatmap that sorts places into work and personal.

releases.name: Nota City 2026-04-20
releases.body: First release. A shared city builder with a 32 by 32 grid, zone, road, power, and water layers, and a backend tick engine that grows population and funds. Added placement rules, a bulldozer, and drag to paint. Roads now show under every layer. Fixed road placement on empty tiles and page loading on refresh.

jobs.description: Shared city builder on a 32 by 32 grid with a backend tick engine.

releases.name: Kitchen Shed Diagram 2026-05-08
releases.body: First release. A 3D exploded view of a 14 by 20 kitchen shed with toggles for shell, loft, water, electrical, kitchen, and restroom layers.

jobs.description: 3D exploded view of a 14 by 20 kitchen shed build.

releases.name: SpaceOut 2026-05-09
releases.body: First release. A brick breaker game with waves, lives, and a saved high score. Swipe, drag, or the on screen buttons move the paddle.

jobs.description: Paddle and ball brick breaker with waves and touch controls.

releases.name: EDMIA 2026-05-21
releases.body: First release. A falling block color match game where clearing squares drives the soundtrack. Includes slide, rotate, drop, and boost controls, song sections that change with level, and a high score table with initials.

jobs.description: Falling block color match game where every move adds to the music.

releases.name: Lead Capture Backend 2026-06-04
releases.body: First release. A lead capture endpoint that stores each submission and sends an email alert.

jobs.description: Lead capture backend that stores form submissions and sends email alerts.

releases.name: Screensaver 2026-06-21
releases.body: First release. An audio reactive screensaver with seven modes: plasma, lines, stars, pipes, matrix, blob, and DVD. It reacts to the microphone or an uploaded song.

jobs.description: Audio reactive screensaver with seven visual modes.

releases.name: Drone Training Page 2026-07-03
releases.body: First release. A landing page for a Part 107 drone pilot training program. Replaced a wrong page that went up first.

jobs.description: Landing page for a Part 107 drone pilot training program in northern Arizona.

releases.name: Tanks and Zombies 2026-07-03
releases.body: First release. A tank versus zombie horde wave shooter with cannon, sea ram, and rocket weapons, a charged shot, and skins that unlock by score. Added a weapon bar and a high score table.

jobs.description: Tank versus zombie horde wave shooter with unlockable skins.
